verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the evidence is a single "Import Users from a CSV" doc title, which shows bulk creation of users but nothing broader. The REST API, MCP server and alert grouping are building blocks or adjacent features, not documented bulk operations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions on incidents (e.g. mass acknowledge/resolve/reassign), bulk operations exposed via API or MCP for AI-driven use, bulk edits beyond user import, and any hands-on corroboration.
